text:
sylvia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to finalize status page wording and decide RCA sharing policy for last outage. Who can own wording, customer summary, and consent flow? Legal flagged PII concerns so want clarity on public vs private RCAs.

kevin: I can take statuspage wording. Will draft a first pass by EOD tomorrow. cc @maria for customer-consent language.

maria: I can do the customer-facing incident summary. Recommend public timeline + root cause + mitigations + next steps. For full RCA, propose public summary + full RCA on request (CSM + consent / NDA).

josh: +1 on public summary + private full RCA. Ops note: recurring pattern — token-cache evictions showed up in 3 incidents over last 6 weeks. Need remediation owner in tracker so we don't re-open.

liz: Legal here — prefer the phrase "technical summary" for public posts. Avoid internal IPs, exact log excerpts, or raw query examples in public copies. We'll review final drafts.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.company/pm/INC-2026-008 — assigned to @sylvia, @kevin

sylvia: Thanks. Kevin, paste proposed statuspage copy here when ready. Maria, can you target a customer-facing summary by Fri 5pm PT? Let's capture action items + owners now.

kevin: Draft below:
```
Status: Partial service degradation affecting text-generation API.
Impact: increased latencies and transient errors for ~12% of requests between 03:12–03:45 UTC.
Current status: Mitigated — we have deployed a rollback and are monitoring.
Next steps: We are completing a postmortem and will publish a customer summary by <date>.
```
Thoughts?

maria: Looks good. Suggest adding: "Data integrity: reports indicate no data loss or corruption" and a "who to contact" line + link to the status update.

sylvia: Agree. Also need to lock RCA sharing policy: public technical summary on statuspage + offer full internal RCA to enterprise customers on request. Require CSM consent and NDA if they request internal logs or raw traces. Owner: @maria to draft consent flow (due Mon EOD). Owner: @josh to own long-term remediation and backlog item (ETA next sprint).

josh: Filed backlog INF-4321 "token-cache eviction guardrails" — owner @josh, ETA ~3 weeks. I'll add acceptance criteria and a detection rule for recurring evictions.

maria: I'll draft the customer email template and consent checkbox language, post here by Mon EOD.

kevin: I'll add Maria's updates into the statuspage copy and ping legal review.

emma: CS note — we'll proactively reach out to top 10 customers by usage. I'll build a simple tracker with owner/email dates and share with @maria and @sylvia.

sylvia: Can we do an async check tomorrow 11:00am PT to review drafts? If no objections I'll send a calendar invite. Final action list I'm capturing:
- Statuspage copy (owner: kevin) — draft by EOD tomorrow
- Customer-facing summary (owner: maria) — draft by Mon EOD
- Consent flow & RCA access process (owner: maria, legal consult: liz) — draft by Mon EOD
- Remediation ticket & ETA (owner: josh) — create ticket and acceptance criteria by next sprint start
- Proactive customer outreach list (owner: emma) — tracker by Tue

kevin: Ack. :thumbsup:

maria: Ack — will post drafts here.

sylvia: Closing the loop: I created an incident-comms board card and assigned tasks. If no objections by 11:30 tomorrow I'll publish the status update draft to staging for legal review. :rocket:
